verdict.rationale: Pipecat is an agent-building framework, so injecting call-time variables and per-caller context is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never documents passing dynamic variables or caller-specific context into a session or prompt. The Cloud public API is said to start agent sessions, and telephony starts from a carrier webhook, but neither item mentions supplying per-caller data to personalize the conversation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inject dynamic variables and per-caller context at call time so each conversation is personalized
